name: io.github.ni-c/wg-easy-mcp
description: Administer wg-easy (WireGuard Easy) v15: manage VPN clients, configs, QR codes and server status

environmentVariables.name: WG_EASY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the wg-easy web UI, e.g. https://vpn.example.com:51821

environmentVariables.name: WG_EASY_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Username of a wg-easy admin account (2FA must be disabled)

environmentVariables.name: WG_EASY_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of the wg-easy admin account

environmentVariables.name: WG_EASY_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept self-signed TLS certificates (scoped to the wg-easy connection)
